sentences.text: Before any formula, you need to know what problem machine learning solves and when it is the right tool.

sentences.text: Key ideas
sentences.say: Key ideas

sentences.text: Ordinary software follows rules a person wrote.
sentences.say: Ordinary software follows rules a person wrote.

sentences.text: Machine learning finds the rules itself from examples.
sentences.say: Machine learning finds the rules itself from examples.

sentences.text: A model is a function that turns inputs into a prediction.
sentences.say: A model is a function that turns inputs into a prediction.

sentences.text: Learning means choosing the numbers inside it (its parameters) so that its predictions match the examples.
sentences.say: Learning means choosing the numbers inside it (its parameters) so that its predictions match the examples.

sentences.text: There are two phases: training (fit the parameters) and inference (use the fitted model on new inputs).
sentences.say: There are two phases: training (fit the parameters) and inference (use the fitted model on new inputs).

sentences.text: Good data matters more than a clever algorithm.
sentences.say: Good data matters more than a clever algorithm.

sentences.text: 1.1 Rules versus examples
sentences.say: 1.1 Rules versus examples

sentences.text: Imagine you must teach a new colleague to spot loan applications that will not be repaid.
sentences.say: Imagine you must teach a new colleague to spot loan applications that will not be repaid.

sentences.text: You have two options.
sentences.say: You have two options.

sentences.text: The first is a rulebook: "decline if income is below X, or if the debt ratio is above Y".
sentences.say: The first is a rulebook: "decline if income is below X, or if the debt ratio is above Y".

sentences.text: The second is to hand over 10,000 past files with their outcomes and let them develop a feel for it.
sentences.say: The second is to hand over 10,000 past files with their outcomes and let them develop a feel for it.

sentences.text: Machine learning is the second option, done by a computer.
sentences.say: Machine learning is the second option, done by a computer.

sentences.text: Arthur Samuel gave the classic definition in 1959: machine learning is the field of study that gives computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed.
sentences.say: Arthur Samuel gave the classic definition in 1959: machine learning is the field of study that gives computers the ability to learn without being explicitly programmed.

sentences.text: His checkers program played tens of thousands of games against itself and ended up playing better than he did (Ng, video 3).
sentences.say: His checkers program played tens of thousands of games against itself and ended up playing better than he did (Ng, video 3).

sentences.text: Nobody wrote its strategy.
sentences.say: Nobody wrote its strategy.

sentences.text: It found one.
sentences.say: It found one.

sentences.text: This matters because some problems have too many rules to write.
sentences.say: This matters because some problems have too many rules to write.

sentences.text: Nobody can list the rules that separate spam from real mail, recognise a voice, or rank web pages.
sentences.say: Nobody can list the rules that separate spam from real mail, recognise a voice, or rank web pages.

sentences.text: For those problems, examples work and rulebooks do not.
sentences.say: For those problems, examples work and rulebooks do not.

sentences.text: 1.2 A model is a small picture of the world
sentences.say: 1.2 A model is a small picture of the world

sentences.text: When you see dark clouds and predict rain, you are using a mental model.
sentences.say: When you see dark clouds and predict rain, you are using a mental model.

sentences.text: A model in machine learning is the same thing written as a function: inputs go in, a prediction comes out.
sentences.say: A model in machine learning is the same thing written as a function: inputs go in, a prediction comes out.

sentences.say: The simplest useful one is a straight line:

sentences.text: The numbers m and b are the parameters.
sentences.say: The numbers m and b are the parameters.

sentences.text: They decide whether the predictions are any good.
sentences.say: They decide whether the predictions are any good.

sentences.text: "Learning" is the search for the m and b that fit the examples best (Shaw Talebi, ML Foundations).
sentences.say: "Learning" is the search for the m and b that fit the examples best (Shaw Talebi, ML Foundations).

sentences.text: 1.3 Training and inference
sentences.say: 1.3 Training and inference

sentences.text: When people say a model "costs" a lot, they usually mean training.
sentences.say: When people say a model "costs" a lot, they usually mean training.

sentences.say: When your app answers a customer, that is inference.

sentences.text: 1.4 Three ways to learn
sentences.say: 1.4 Three ways to learn

sentences.text: Supervised learning: every example comes with the right answer.
sentences.say: Supervised learning: every example comes with the right answer.

sentences.text: The model learns to map inputs to answers.
sentences.say: The model learns to map inputs to answers.

sentences.text: Most business ML is this.
sentences.say: Most business ML is this.

sentences.text: Unsupervised learning: there are no answers.
sentences.say: Unsupervised learning: there are no answers.

sentences.text: The model looks for structure by itself, such as groups of similar customers.
sentences.say: The model looks for structure by itself, such as groups of similar customers.

sentences.text: Reinforcement learning: the model tries actions and gets a reward or a penalty.
sentences.say: Reinforcement learning: the model tries actions and gets a reward or a penalty.

sentences.text: It learns by trial and error.
sentences.say: It learns by trial and error.

sentences.text: AlphaGo used it, and so did the training of reasoning models such as DeepSeek R1, which were rewarded for correct maths and code answers.
sentences.say: AlphaGo used it, and so did the training of reasoning models such as DeepSeek R1, which were rewarded for correct maths and code answers.

sentences.text: Chapter 2 covers all three in detail.
sentences.say: Chapter 2 covers all three in detail.

sentences.text: Deep learning is not a fourth way to learn.
sentences.say: Deep learning is not a fourth way to learn.

sentences.text: It is a kind of model, a neural network with many layers, that can be trained in any of the three ways, most often the first.
sentences.say: It is a kind of model, a neural network with many layers, that can be trained in any of the three ways, most often the first.

sentences.text: 1.5 AI, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs
sentences.say: 1.5 AI, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs

sentences.text: These terms nest like Russian dolls.
sentences.say: These terms nest like Russian dolls.

sentences.text: Artificial intelligence is the broad goal.
sentences.say: Artificial intelligence is the broad goal.

sentences.text: Machine learning is the part of it that learns from data.
sentences.say: Machine learning is the part of it that learns from data.

sentences.text: Deep learning is the part of machine learning that uses large neural networks.
sentences.say: Deep learning is the part of machine learning that uses large neural networks.

sentences.text: A large language model (LLM) is a deep network trained on huge amounts of text to predict the next word, then refined with supervised examples and reinforcement learning.
sentences.say: A large language model (LLM) is a deep network trained on huge amounts of text to predict the next word, then refined with supervised examples and reinforcement learning.

sentences.text: This book moves in that order: classical machine learning first, because LLMs reuse its ideas.

sentences.text: 1.6 Where machine learning is used
sentences.say: 1.6 Where machine learning is used

sentences.text: You already use it many times a day: web search ranking, tagging friends in photos, movie recommendations, voice assistants and spam filters.
